title: Behen Hogi Teri
desc: A man deeply loves a girl everyone insists he treat as a sister, but he refuses to bow to the rule and boldly decides to stand up and fight for his love.

title: Andaz Apna Apna
desc: Amar and Prem are broke dreamers chasing the same rich heiress, Raveena, but their silly feud gets wildly out of hand after crossing paths with dangerous gangster Teja.

title: Koyla
desc: Shankar, a mute servant, tricks Gauri into marrying his employer with a false photo. But Gauri falls for Shankar, fighting against odds to be with him.

title: Satyam Shivam Sundaram
desc: Rajeev marries Roopa, a beautiful singer, but he struggles to accept her when he discovers her disfigured face, causing emotional pain and conflict in their relationship.

title: Singham Again
desc: When ruthless enemies kidnap his beloved wife, fearless police officer Bajirao Singham rallies his trusted force to execute a high-stakes, explosive rescue mission and bring justice.

title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
desc: Pawan, a devotee of Lord Hanuman, finds a girl who is speech-impaired lost in Haryana. He soon learns that she is from Pakistan and sets out to reunite her with her family at great personal cost.

title: Kites
desc: Jay, a Las Vegas dance teacher, marries women for green cards. He weds Natasha for the same reason but unexpectedly falls in love when they reunite, complicating his plans.

title: Mili
desc: Mili Naudiyal works in a restaurant while preparing to move to Canada. Her life turns into a survival battle when she's accidentally locked inside a freezer.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Prem
desc: Sanjay is haunted by visions of his past life as Shantanu. His world shifts when he meets Sonia, who resembles a woman from his visions, drawing him into a mysterious fate.

title: Mera Gaon Mera Desh
desc: A reformed man bravely opposes a ruthless village tyrant, but when his beloved is kidnapped, the confrontation turns personal, forcing a fierce battle for justice.

title: Ankhiyon Ke Jharokhon Se
desc: College rivals Lily and Arun fall in love with their parents' support, but their dreams are shattered when she is diagnosed with leukaemia, testing their strength and bond.

title: Saudagar
desc: The friendship between Veeru and Rajeshwar turns into a bitter rivalry over time. Years later, they confront each other again when their grandchildren fall in love.

title: Gully Boy
desc: Murad, an underdog from Dharavi, struggles to express his reality and social issues through rap, until meeting local rapper MC Sher, whose guidance transforms his confidence and dreams.

title: Pardes
desc: Kishorilal chooses Ganga for his NRI son. But Ganga shares a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son, leading to a conflict between duty and love.

title: Crook
desc: Jai, a small-time crook equipped with a new identity, is sent to Australia by his uncle. However, there he gets embroiled in the ongoing racial conflict while also trying to pursue his love interest.

title: Dhaakad
desc: Agent Agni reluctantly accepts a mission to capture Rudraveer, a dangerous trafficker. Her journey takes unexpected turns, pushing her into uncharted paths filled with risk and discovery.
